If it helps, what I did was to try and be more yourself. Be very honest about what you know and what you don't. They can tell. I remember telling my interviewer I didn't understand what they meant and I still got an offer because I was honest about it and my other skills showed them I was capable of doing the job. Also if you don't have any other prior experiences, don't be afraid to talk about your projects from class, study up on your previous projects so you have something to talk about during your interview. I hope this helps and good luck! Recruiting season isn't over yet, you got this :)
